value.name: rsi_reversion
value.rationale: The Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes. Markets frequently exhibit short‑term mean‑reversion when RSI reaches extreme overbought (>70) or oversold (<30) levels, reflecting temporary excess optimism or pessimism. By scaling positions to -1, 0, or +1 based on these thresholds, the strategy aims to capture the ensuing pull‑backs while staying flat during neutral regimes. This approach is distinct from the existing trend‑following, breakout, and Bollinger/z‑score methods because it relies on a momentum oscillator rather than price channels or volatility bands.
